rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the sacred or inviolable status of something.

example.english: The sanctity of this land must not be casually destroyed.
example.traditional: 呢片土地嘅神聖性，唔可以畀人隨便破壞。
example.jyutping: ne1 pin3 tou2 dei6 ge3 san4 sing3 sing3 m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 jan4 ceoi4 bin6 po3 waai6

rows.note: Use this when the focus is specifically on something being inviolable or not to be violated.

example.english: The law must protect the sanctity of private homes.
example.traditional: 私人住所嘅不可侵犯性，法律一定要保障。
example.jyutping: si1 jan4 zyu6 so2 ge3 bat1 ho2 cam1 faan6 sing3 faat3 leot6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 bou2 zoeng3

rows.note: Use this in religious or moral contexts for holiness of character or disposition.

example.english: Everyone admired the sanctity of her character.
example.traditional: 佢一生行善，大家都好敬佩佢嘅聖潔性。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 saang1 hang4 sin6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 ging3 pui3 keoi5 ge3 sing3 git3 sing3
